verdict.rationale: Buzz's own Helm chart documents a distinct "Quickstart (eval)" profile with in-cluster Postgres, Redis and MinIO and auto-generated secrets, separate from the production profile. The live GHCR chart listing and the single-node compose bundle confirm you can stand up an isolated instance to test against without touching a production deployment. This is an evaluation deployment rather than a purpose-built sandbox mode or test tenant for agents, so it only glancingly covers the story. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test mode within a workspace, seeded test data or isolation guarantees for agent experimentation, guidance on testing safely against production-like setups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
